산책하다.m: to take a walk, to stroll
산책하다.x: After dinner, I take a walk in the park.
산책하다.e: Sino-Korean, but 책 here isn't 'book' — just learn 산책 (a walk) whole.

서랍.x: The socks are in the bottom drawer.

취직.x: I got a job after graduating from college.

스승의 날.ex: 스승의 날에 선생님께 감사 편지를 썼어요.
스승의 날.x: On Teachers' Day, I wrote my teacher a thank-you letter.
스승의 날.e: 스승 is a respectful native word for 'teacher, mentor'.
스승의 날.t: The particle 의 here is usually pronounced [에]: [스승에 날].

도입.m: introduction (of a system or technology), adoption
도입.ex: 새 제도의 도입으로 많은 것이 바뀌었어요.
도입.x: A lot changed with the introduction of the new system.
도입.t: 도입 is for introducing systems or technology; for introducing people, use 소개.

공기 청정기.ex: 미세먼지가 심해서 공기 청정기를 계속 틀어 놨어요.
공기 청정기.x: The fine dust is bad, so I've kept the air purifier running.
공기 청정기.e: 空氣 'air' + 淸淨 'clean, pure' + 機 'machine'.
공기 청정기.t: Turn it on with 켜다 or 틀다. A standard appliance in Korean homes because of 미세먼지 (fine dust). Also written 공기청정기.

걸작.ex: 많은 사람들이 그 그림을 화가의 최고 걸작으로 꼽아요.
걸작.x: Many people consider that painting the artist's greatest masterpiece.
걸작.t: Pronounced [걸짝]; casually 걸작이다 can also mean something is hilarious.

선정하다.x: The judges selected the best work of the year.
선정하다.e: Literally 'choose and fix' — picking officially after review.

운행하다.e: Literally 'move and go' — vehicles running on a route.

편집.x: Video editing takes a lot of time.

조명하다.m: to illuminate, to shed light on, to spotlight (a topic)
조명하다.ex: 이 책은 청년 실업 문제를 깊이 조명하고 있어요.
조명하다.x: This book takes an in-depth look at youth unemployment.
조명하다.e: Literally 'shine bright'; the noun 조명 also means stage or room lighting.

진정으로.ex: 그는 자신의 잘못을 진정으로 반성하고 있어요.
진정으로.x: He is sincerely reflecting on his mistake.

안전 불감증.ex: 안전 불감증이 큰 사고로 이어질 수 있습니다.
안전 불감증.x: Complacency about safety can lead to major accidents.
안전 불감증.e: Literally 'safety numbness syndrome' — not feeling danger at all.

트집.m: faultfinding, nitpicking, picking a fight over nothing
트집.ex: 그는 괜히 음식 맛에 트집을 잡았어요.
트집.x: He found fault with the taste of the food for no reason.
트집.e: Probably first meant a crack or gap in something; it now means a pretext for complaining.
트집.t: Used as 트집을 잡다; 꼬투리 is a small detail grabbed, 트집 is the act of complaining about it.

심증.x: The detective became convinced that he was the culprit.
심증.e: Literally 'proof in the heart' — what you believe before you can prove it.

서명날인.ex: 본인 확인 후 아래 칸에 서명날인해 주시기 바랍니다.
서명날인.x: After verifying your identity, please sign and stamp in the box below.
서명날인.e: 서명 'signature' plus 날인 'seal' — formal documents often want both.

무역수지.ex: 반도체 수출 덕분에 무역수지가 흑자로 돌아섰어요.
무역수지.x: Thanks to chip exports, the trade balance turned to a surplus.

시세차익.m: capital gain, profit from a price difference
시세차익.ex: 그는 주식을 팔아서 큰 시세차익을 얻었어요.
시세차익.x: He made a big profit by selling his stocks.
시세차익.e: 시세 'current market price' + 차익 'profit from a difference.'

손익계산서.m: income statement, profit and loss statement
손익계산서.ex: 손익계산서에서 매출과 비용을 확인할 수 있습니다.
손익계산서.x: You can check revenue and expenses on the income statement.

긴장완화.ex: 남북 대화가 한반도의 긴장완화에 도움이 됐어요.
긴장완화.x: Inter-Korean dialogue helped ease tensions on the Korean Peninsula.
긴장완화.e: Literally 'loosening what is tight and stretched'.
긴장완화.t: 긴장 고조 (rising tension) is the opposite you'll see in the same news stories.

면구스럽다.m: to be ashamed, embarrassed (to face someone)
면구스럽다.ex: 도와주신 분께 연락을 못 드려서 면구스러워요.
면구스럽다.x: I feel ashamed that I never got in touch with the person who helped me.
면구스럽다.e: Hanja suggest a face that burns, as with shame; rather old-fashioned today.

타당도.ex: 측정 도구의 타당도를 먼저 확인해야 합니다.
타당도.x: We must first check the validity of the measurement tool.
타당도.e: Literally 'degree of being proper and fitting'.
타당도.t: -도 = 'degree of': 신뢰도, 타당도, 만족도 (satisfaction level), 인지도 (name recognition).

졸작.x: It's a humble effort, but thank you for reading it to the end.
졸작.t: Writers humbly call their own work 졸작; saying it about someone else's work is a harsh insult.

지평.ex: 그 연구는 과학의 새로운 지평을 열었어요.
지평.x: That research opened new horizons for science.
지평.e: Literally 'flat earth': where the land meets the sky; 지평선 is the horizon line.
지평.t: Common collocation: 새로운 지평을 열다, 'to open new horizons.'

일목요연.m: clear at a glance, neatly organized
일목요연.ex: 이 표는 자료가 일목요연하게 정리되어 있어요.
일목요연.x: This table organizes the data so it's clear at a glance.
일목요연.t: Pronounced [일모교연]; most often used as 일목요연하게 정리하다.

함흥차사.m: someone who never comes back or replies, no news at all
함흥차사.ex: 한 시간 전에 심부름 간 동생이 아직도 함흥차사예요.
함흥차사.x: My brother went on an errand an hour ago and still hasn't come back.
함흥차사.e: From the Joseon story of royal envoys sent to Hamheung who never returned.
함흥차사.t: Common and humorous in everyday speech for someone who's taking forever.
